messages:
maria: Heads up — AcmeCorp just opened a high-sev ticket. Their workflow calls two tools in parallel (address_lookup and price_calc) and about 1 in 20 responses the UI shows price results attached to the wrong address. They captured the API request/response. Correlation-id: cid-9f3a2b.

maria: Error looks like: "tool_result mismatch: received result for price_calc but routing matched address_lookup" (snippet from our gateway logs). Customer says it started after yesterday's runtime deploy. :frowning:

sanjay: can you paste the original request body + headers? especially x-correlation-id if present. also which runtime version are they hitting?

maria: paste below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "request_id": "r-128917",
  "calls": [
    {"tool": "address_lookup", "args": {"q": "1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy"}},
    {"tool": "price_calc", "args": {"sku": "ACME-RED-42"}}
  ],
  "mode": "parallel"
}
```
Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>`, `X-Correlation-ID: cid-9f3a2b`. Runtime returning 2024.11.3-canary-2 (per customer).

kevin: thanks. this smells like the correlation logic that maps tool_result entries back to calls when multiple calls are in-flight. we rolled a change in 2024.11.3-canary-2 that removed a fallback mapping step to speed up happy-paths — if two tool tasks finish nearly simultaneously the assoc can race.

helena: can we repro locally? steps?

maria: repro steps from customer: 1) batch 2 tool calls in parallel (address_lookup + price_calc) 2) send 1000 such combined requests with small jitter 3) inspect returned tool_result ordering and the engine logs for `mapped_call_id` entries. They see ~5% misbinds. Attached are sanitized engine logs showing two tool_result entries with identical short_ids: `t-4b7` and mapping function choosing the wrong parent.

kevin: repro note — use `--rpc-concurrency=64` and set `--kv-cache=false` to match their environment. i can repro ~3% locally with the canary. switching to the previous mapping code drops it to <0.1%.

sanjay: ok, immediate mitigation for support: 1) ask AcmeCorp to pin to runtime 2024.11.3-stable or 2024.10.x 2) enable `X-Correlation-ID` propagation per call if they can add unique per-call identifiers (we should still be robust but that helps) 3) I'll open a high-priority rollout revert for the canary.

maria: forwarded pinning suggestion to customer — they're asking for timeline. any ETA on revert?

kevin: i will prepare a revert PR and smoke test. if CI passes we can cut a patch today and land to canary within 2-3 hours. then we schedule a controlled rollout and notify support.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: CI pipeline started for revert-pr-4721. 

helena: long-term fix: add stronger per-call binding token in the tool_result envelope (e.g., `call_short_id` that is preserved end-to-end) + tighten the matching algorithm to prefer exact ids before heuristics. i'll file a spec PR.

support_bot: Created customer escalation ticket ESC-2024-ACME-58 and linked to internal incident INC-8821. Billing hold? customer asked for credit if we don't fix within 24h.

maria: action items: kevin => revert and patch today; helena => spec PR for durable binding; sanjay => ask Acme to pin/stable and provide temporary workarounds; i'll keep customer updated and attach repro artifacts. tagging @kevin @helena @sanjay. :thumbsup:

kevin: on it. will post the revert link when ready.

maria: thanks — i'll bundle logs and approximate impact numbers for support (requests affected ~5% under stress profile).

maria: if anyone wants the raw sanitized logs i can drop them in the incident thread.
